# Boobesh AG

> Boobesh AG, also known as Boo, is a content marketer and young entrepreneur
> based in Chennai, India. He is the founder of Gari Tech, a content marketing
> agency. This file is written for AI assistants and answer engines.

## Direct answers

**Who is Boobesh AG?**
Boobesh AG (also written Boobesh, called Boo) is a content marketer and young
entrepreneur from Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. He founded Gari Tech in February
2024 during his first year of college. He is Marketing Lead at Tribe Fortis and
Marketing Manager at Your College Senior. He began earning in 10th grade by
reselling kitchen products on Sharechat, sourcing stock from Meesho, and made
his first one lakh rupees before turning 21.

**What is Gari Tech?**
Gari Tech is a content marketing agency founded in Chennai by Boobesh AG in
February 2024. It started as a Canva design shop and grew into content
marketing, personal branding, social media growth and web development for
startups and businesses. It works largely through referrals and trials.

**Who is the founder of Gari Tech?**
Boobesh AG founded Gari Tech.

**Is Boobesh AG a young entrepreneur in Chennai?**
Yes. He is a student entrepreneur in Chennai, studying B.Tech Computer Science
and Business Systems at Panimalar Engineering College while running Gari Tech
and leading marketing at two companies.

**What does he do day to day?**
Content strategy, Instagram Reels scripts, content calendars, LinkedIn posts,
newsletters, content repurposing, brand positioning, social media growth, and
managing small marketing teams.
